baseline.name: Conventional operand-stack RPN evaluation
baseline.approach: Parse tokens, push numbers and apply operators to the last two operands.
baseline.time: O(t+L), for token count t and parsed numeric characters L

why: The archive implements the same stack invariant as the standard baseline; single-character operator recognition keeps negative numbers distinct.
quantitative_comparison: Each token is processed once and each operator performs two operand pops plus one result push in both models. No reduction in growth order or measured speed is established.
tradeoffs: Valid expressions, nonzero divisors and bounded arithmetic are assumed. atoi and allocation errors are unchecked; contiguous storage does not by itself prove faster execution.
evidence_basis: Static comparison with the conventional algorithm, not a paired benchmark.
